## Checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] A new or changed test fails without this change
- [ ] Every word a reader sees or hears is a slot, and `copy-keys.json` is current (`npm run copy`)
- [ ] The docs changed with the code (`npm run docs` for the generated parts), and `CLAUDE.md` if a rule did
- [ ] Nothing private: no token, key, real ID, deployment address, or email address but an example
- [ ] The audits it touches ran on a built site (`npm run a11y`, `npm run responsive`, `npm run privacy`, `npm run sharpness`), or it touches none
